_meta.description: Check whether a picture carries the invisible mark Ari Helper adds to images it generates. Runs entirely in your browser — nothing is uploaded.
caveat: A mark that is found is reliable: the pattern it looks for does not occur by chance, so a picture reporting Ari's mark really does carry it. A mark that is not found proves much less. Heavy compression, cropping, resizing and screenshots all destroy it, and this says nothing about pictures from any other tool. It is also not a signature — it shows a picture came from Ari, not who made it.
drop: Drop a picture here, or click to choose one
drop-hint: PNG, JPEG, HEIC or any picture your browser can open
explain-found: This picture carries the invisible mark Ari Helper adds to images it generates.
explain-missing: This picture does not carry the mark — but see the note below before concluding anything from that.
lede: Ari Helper can add an invisible mark to pictures it generates. Drop one here to see whether it carries that mark. The picture never leaves your device — the check runs in this page.
step-1: Ari nudges the fine detail of every small square of the image, not its metadata, so a re-save doesn't strip it.
step-2: This page reads those squares with the same arithmetic, in your browser, and counts how many agree.
step-3: When enough squares agree they spell out Ari's fixed pattern, which ordinary pictures never do by chance.
title: Check for Ari's mark
